practices.summary: Items are limited to 400 KB; projections larger than that signal an aggregation problem, not a paging problem.
A single partition supports ~1000 WCU / 3000 RCU; static analysis can flag concentration risk but never measured throughput.
Scan/Query pages return at most 1 MB before filtering - FilterExpression does not reduce read cost.
Default quota is 20 GSIs per table; provisioning more indexes than access paths used is waste.
